label: EVALS
author: Mike

slides.headline: Two kinds of [harness]
slides.body: An agent harness runs the loop and hands the model its tools. An evaluation harness runs the evals end to end and adds up the results.

slides.headline: One graph, [14 steps]
rows: Reads the transcript, proposes the clips
I watch raw cuts, keep or kill each one
Refuses done while any lane is pending

slides.headline: Rules live [in the code]
slides.body: A rule that only lives in the context is a request. The prompt explains the job. The code enforces the rules.

slides.headline: The fix had [three parts]
rows: Every keep or kill, per gate

slides.headline: A score [moves by itself]
slides.stat_sub: percent on the second run, {100} on the first
slides.body: Same prompt, same transcript, same model. The difference was one impact cut.

slides.headline: What the [record] shows
slides.body: {184} lines covering {21} livestreams, every keep or kill on record.

slides.headline: The finding I [didn't expect]
rows: {11} of {17} were half of a pair

slides.headline: Opinions become [replays]
slides.body: Can a cheaper model pick as well? That used to be an opinion. Now it's a replay.

slides.headline: Watch the [full video]
slides.sub: Evals in Production: Turning Human Verdicts Into a Score
